0.original: You cannot help but feel something is bothering Y'shtola.

25.original: Wait at the entrance to Slitherbough.

27.original: Speak with the manager of suites in the Pendants.

48.original: What <hex:021A020203>Master Matoya<hex:021A020103> did was completely and utterly reckless... But if not for her, a great many of the Night's Blessed would not be here.

49.original: Considering the Blessed have only just recovered from their encounter with the Eulmorans, Thancred and the others thought we should stay a while longer to be sure they're all right.

50.original: They're such a kind and caring people. I pray they never again have to face such hardship.

51.original: It seems the Blessed were spared the worst of the Eulmorans' assault, for the better part of Ran'jit's forces abandoned Slitherbough in our pursuit.

52.original: Had he been but a few steps faster, he may well hath foiled our efforts to slay the Lightwarden.

53.original: Though it pains me to leave, it is time I returned with you and the others to the Crystarium.

54.original: But before we go, might I speak with you in private? I will await you in my chambers.

55.original: Thank you for coming. I thought to keep my suspicions to myself, but after witnessing your victory at Rak'tika Falls, I fear they prove true, and so I must share them with you.

56.original: From the first when we met at Fort Gohn, your aether has appeared...tainted. Suffused with an overabundance of light not unlike the sin eaters.

57.original: When you defeated the Lightwarden, I fear the light which poured forth from it was not negated by Hydaelyn's blessing. Rather, it was absorbed into your being.

58.original: Urianger also suspects as much, though he is unwilling to share his thoughts on the matter.

59.original: One thing is certain: with every Warden you defeat, the danger to you grows greater. Greater perhaps than we can imagine. If you begin to feel anything strange─anything at all─pray inform me at once.

60.original: You should hurry, before the others begin to worry. Once I have sorted my things here I will join you.

61.original: Pray go on ahead. I would first attend to this unsightly collection of books.

62.original: <sigh> I'd always complained that her cave was such a mess, books and scrolls strewn about like a child's playthings. Gods, I really <hex:021A020203>am<hex:021A020103> turning into her...

63.original: We took one last patrol of the perimeter. All things considered, Slitherbough remains relatively unscathed.

64.original: Thanks to the antidote, all those who were poisoned will make a full recovery.

65.original: And with the night sky returned, their prayers have at last been answered.

66.original: Sorry to keep you all waiting. Shall we be off, then?

67.original: Art thou certain this is best?

68.original: ...I'll not deny there is a part of me that wishes I could stay.

69.original: For two years I have lived with the Blessed, learned their culture, even going so far as to adopt Master Matoya's name as my own. I but pray I did honor to it.

70.original: Now is not the time for doubt or hesitation. Come, we must return to the Crystarium.

71.original: Hopefully the others will arrive before long.

72.original: I know he said he would be watching from the shadows, but doesn't it seem wrong to leave without at least telling Emet-Selch?

73.original: 'Twas passing strange to see the Crystarium so seemingly desolate, yet it appears all is well.

74.original: All things considered, it is hardly surprising that Alphinaud and Alisaie have yet to arrive, but where is the Exarch?

75.original: My friends! 'Tis good to see you all again.

76.original: Alphinaud! It has been too long.

77.original: I assume your presence here means you've brought word of the Warden hiding in Rak'tika?

78.original: Found and slain, you say? I should have known.

79.original: Eulmore has but recently dispatched soldiers to all corners of Norvrandt to defend them. I am glad to see their efforts were wasted on the Greatwood.

80.original: Speaking of Eulmore, what came of your meeting with Vauthry?

81.original: Yes, about that. It proved to be...

83.original: Exarch, you mustn't push yourself. Your time away from the tower has clearly taken its toll.

84.original: No doubt you all are tired as well, having traveled so far. Why don't we all take a much-needed rest before we discuss our findings?

85.original: I thought to propose the very same. After your clash with the Warden, you deserve a chance to recuperate.

86.original: It's settled, then. We reconvene after everyone has had time to settle in.

87.original: Welcome back, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. Returned from a lengthy excursion, I take it.

88.original: Well, your room has been made ready, if you'd care to retire?

90.original: Very good. I pray you sound sleep and pleasant dreams.
